{{Top|leg}}
'''Polyweave''' was a synthetic fabric used to make acceleration straps and netting aboard [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|36|Polyweave}}</ref> such as the restraints attached to [[shock couch]]es in the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]].<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
